title: VeriBase: Automated Construction of Theorem Libraries for Software Verification
title_zh: VeriBase：面向软件验证的定理库自动构建

paragraphs.en: VeriBase从成功的验证方案中自动泛化代码与定理，构建软件验证库，使任务成功率提升17%。 Software verification is typically more challenging than coding. Software developers routinely build on mature libraries and APIs, but turning successful verification solutions into reusable libraries still requires substantial expert effort. In this paper, we propose VeriBase, a framework for automatically constructing software-verification libraries by jointly generalizing code and its associated theorems from successful verification solutions. The key challenge is to generalize implementations together with the theorem statements and proofs that depend on these implementations, and reconcile overlapping components across verification tasks. To this end, VeriBase treats code and its associated theorems as declaration families, and designs a three-phase pipeline, which proves seed tasks, generalizes code and associated theorems, and harvests the resulting families into shared interfaces. VeriBase updates dependent declarations as interface change and uses Lean to check the resulting code and proofs. We evaluate VeriBase across four benchmarks with three backend LLMs. The results show that the general-purpose library built from independent 4,191 programs increases the average task success rate by up to 17.0% and meanwhile reduces the proof completion time by up to 21.4%. When VeriBase constructs a benchmark-specific library, further improvement can be observed.
paragraphs.zh: VeriBase 从成功的验证方案中自动泛化代码与定理，构建软件验证库，使任务成功率提升 17%。软件验证通常比编写代码更具挑战性。 软件开发者通常基于成熟的库和 API 进行开发，但将成功的验证方案转化为可复用的库仍然需要大量的专家投入。 在本文中，我们提出了 VeriBase，这是一个通过从成功的验证方案中联合泛化代码及其相关定理来自动构建软件验证库的框架。 关键挑战在于将实现与其所依赖的定理陈述及证明一同进行泛化，并协调不同验证任务之间重叠的组件。 为此，VeriBase 将代码及其相关定理视为声明族，并设计了一个三阶段流水线：先证明种子任务，再泛化代码与相关定理，最后将所得的声明族整合到共享接口中。 VeriBase 在接口变化时更新依赖的声明，并使用 Lean 来检查生成的代码与证明。 我们在四个基准测试上使用三个后端大语言模型对 VeriBase 进行了评估。 结果表明，由独立的 4,191 个程序构建的通用库可将平均任务成功率提升至多 17.0%，同时将证明完成时间缩短至多 21.4%。 当 VeriBase 构建针对特定基准的库时，可以观察到进一步的提升。
